params.1274: Use a bucket, jug or bowl with any sink, pump or tap to fill it with water. The general store can sell you a bucket for 2 coins.
params.1275: Follow the road north out of Lumbridge and pass both the general store and Fred's sheep and chicken farm until you reach a crossroads at a wheat field.
params.1276: Alternatively, head south from the Varrock clay pits to the same crossroads (Beefy Bill has buckets of water for sale too!).
params.1277: Keep heading west to the next crossroads and take the west fork; the potter's house will be the first house to your south.
params.1278: In the house, use the bucket of water with some clay you have mined to make soft clay.
params.1279: You can use clay on a water source directly to soften it; however, to complete this Task you need to be standing inside the house so a bucket is necessary.
params.1292: This Beginner Task is part of the Lumbridge set.
